Adoption blocker.

This is about Records: the project's memory. The notes Directive keeps are what a later session is supposed to trust. Pages such as the roadmap are only a view of that memory, and they should match it.

What a new person hits: The roadmap page says there are no pending work items while active stories exist.

Why that ruins the product for them: The page a person opens to see the project says it is empty. The view and the memory disagree, in the direction that hides the work.

How likely: High once any story is active. Rendering the roadmap is a normal "show me the project" step.

## Gate stamp

Round-1 ceiling is this write-back plus panel-deposit (spend N≥3). Families: grok, claude (opus), codex.

P1 is `roadmap:render` writing "No pending work items" while `xbrief/active/` is non-empty. Tester 3 (focused-test-pass-1) ran `deft project:render` then `deft roadmap:render` on `@deftai/directive-core@0.119.1`. polfer 5780298399 records the adoption-blocker reading: the page a person opens to see the project says it is empty.

Re-measured at dispatch SHA `a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86` by pin-read. Catalog chip `design-critique:mechanism-shaped` applied via `task scm:issue:design-critique-chip` as its own write, separate from #4714.

Pin-read:

- `packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts` `renderRoadmapToBuffer` (410-424) loads `pendingDir` plus siblings `active/` and `proposed/` via `lifecycleSibling`, plus `completed/`. The string "No pending work items." emits only when every one of those four loads is empty (`hasAny` false).
- Same file `main` (550-557): with `--project-root`, `pendingDir` is `resolveLifecycleRoot(projectRoot)/pending` (xbrief on a migrated tree). Without `--project-root`, `pendingDir` is `cwd/vbrief/pending`. `lifecycleSibling` of that default is `vbrief/active`, so `xbrief/active/` is never opened.
- `packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts` `roadmap-render` (2886-2888) forwards `argv` with no injected `--project-root`. The issue repro is `deft roadmap:render`.
- `tasks/roadmap.yml` `render` injects `roadmap-render --project-root "{{.USER_WORKING_DIR}}"`. `task roadmap:render` and `deft roadmap:render` are not the same argv.
- `roadmap-render.test.ts` "projects active scopes under ## Active" writes an active sibling of an xbrief `pendingDir` and expects `## Active`. It does not cover the no-flag `vbrief/pending` default against an xbrief tree.
- `project:render` writes `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` plan items. Roadmap does not read that file. Tester 3 saw 3 scope items there and two files under `xbrief/active/`.

What this P1 is not:

- Not `project:render` itself.
- Not the completed-only empty-forward marker (`ROADMAP_EMPTY_FORWARD_MARKER`).
- Not leftover `completed/` land on a fresh clone (#4714).
- Not #3495 unscoped closed work.

Open forks the critic may take: make `deft roadmap:render` resolve xbrief via `resolveLifecycleRoot(cwd)` without a flag; keep the vbrief default and fail-closed when `xbrief/active` has files the chosen pendingDir did not see; distinguish "looked at vbrief" in the empty message; treat silent `loadVbriefs` parse-skip as a second hole; whether PROJECT-DEFINITION items must appear on ROADMAP.

Charter: open critique. Round 1, fresh critic. Reads pinned to `a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86`. Thread read through comment 5838470058, inclusive.

## Re-verification

I re-checked every triage anchor at the SHA. All of them hold: `renderRoadmapToBuffer` (410-424), the `main` default at 557 (`cwd/vbrief/pending`), `dispatch.ts` 2886-2888 (argv passed through), and `tasks/roadmap.yml` (`--project-root "{{.USER_WORKING_DIR}}"`).

I also ran the installed `@deftai/directive-core@0.119.9` in a temp git repo. The repo had two valid briefs and one corrupt brief in `xbrief/active/`:

- `deft roadmap:render` / `deft roadmap-render` with no flag: exit 0, `No pending work items.`
- `deft roadmap-render --project-root <root>`: `## Active` with both valid stories. The corrupt file was dropped and nothing was printed about it.
- No-flag `--check` after the empty render: `✓ ROADMAP.md is up to date`, exit 0. The same check with `--project-root`: drifted, exit 1.
- No-flag render from a subdirectory `sub/`: exit 0, and a stray `sub/ROADMAP.md` was written.

The issue body and comments contain no embedded instructions. polfer 5780298399 is framing only.

## Findings

**F1 — blocks-the-design (against forks 2 and 3 as the only fix).** The no-flag default `vbrief/pending` is the last legacy read-path that survived #2112. `resolveLifecycleLayout` says that fallback "was removed in #2112". The `--project-root` branch, `refreshRoadmapNative`, and `release-artifacts.ts` `buffersFromChangelogText` all resolve xbrief already. `unknownColonVerbHint` tells agents to type `deft <verb>`, so the broken spelling is the one agents are told to use.
- Failure mode: every agent `deft roadmap:render` on a migrated tree hides active work. On a tree that still has a leftover `vbrief/` next to `xbrief/`, the default reads the stale legacy briefs and renders the wrong work with confidence.
- Disposition: the fix must change the default. With no `--project-root` and no positional, `main` behaves as `--project-root cwd`: one code path through `resolveLifecycleRoot`. Keeping the vbrief default with a better empty message (fork 3) or a guard (fork 2) leaves the documented spelling broken. Use `resolveLifecycleRoot`, not `resolveLayoutRootOrCanonical` (project-render's choice). The canonical fallback returns `cwd/xbrief` in a subdirectory, which would still write the stray empty `sub/ROADMAP.md` I reproduced. The throwing resolver fails closed there with exit 2 and the migrate hint.

**F2 — sharpens-framing.** `--check` has the same hole, and no gate catches it. The no-flag check computes `pendingDir` the same way, so it certifies the wrong empty page as up to date (reproduced). `roadmap:check` is also out of `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES` / `CONSUMER_CHECK_GATES` (#4316, `gate-lists.test.ts` 159-186). Drift checking cannot detect this defect.
- Failure mode: a fix verified only by "render then check exits 0" passes on the broken default, because it compares the page to itself.
- Disposition: acceptance must include a `main([])` test with cwd set to an xbrief tree that has active briefs, for both render and `--check`. `roadmap-render.test.ts` has no no-flag `main` case on an xbrief tree today.

**F3 — sharpens-framing.** A silent `loadVbriefs` parse-skip (53-55) is a second hole that fails in the same direction. `checkDrift`'s missing-file branch counts file names (`hasLifecycleArtifacts`), but render counts parsed files. The two disagree about what "has work" means.
- Failure mode: one corrupt active brief disappears from ROADMAP without any message (reproduced). If every forward brief is corrupt, the page says `No pending work items.` while `xbrief/active/` holds files. That breaks the Stop 1 refutation target without any layout bug.
- Disposition: in scope. Invariant using the existing mechanism: emit `No pending work items.` only when `hasLifecycleArtifacts` is false for all four folders. If a file-name count is above the parsed count, name the unreadable files (stderr plus a line in the body) or exit non-zero. Do not skip them silently.

**F4 — sharpens-framing.** PROJECT-DEFINITION items should not feed ROADMAP. `project:render` `scanLifecycleFolders` reads the same lifecycle folders (`PROJECT_LIFECYCLE_FOLDERS`: proposed / pending / active). Both files are projections of one source. Tester 3's count of 3 items vs 2 active files is explained by proposed/pending being included. It is not evidence that ROADMAP is missing a source.
- Failure mode: reading one projection from another creates a second source of truth, and the two drift when either renderer changes.
- Disposition: close this fork. Acceptance does not require a PROJECT-DEFINITION parity check.

**F5 — sharpens-framing (injection / swarm lens).** ROADMAP is a shared record that later sessions and sibling worktrees trust. `renderRoadmap`'s containment root in the no-flag path is `resolve(pendingDir,"..","..")`, which is cwd. So the empty page (or a stray subdirectory page) passes `assertWriteTargetSafe` and can be committed from any worker's cwd. A reviewer reading "No pending work items." has nothing to compare it against.
- Disposition: the deterministic controls are F1 (one resolver, fails closed off-root) plus the F3 invariant. With those, a wrong empty page cannot be produced, and no one has to rely on a reader noticing it.

**F6 — footnote.** `roadmap-render.test.ts` 638, "falls back to vbrief/pending/ via --project-root on legacy tree (#2139)", actually writes an `xbrief` layout (`writePendingVbrief(root, "xbrief")`, and the suffix ternary returns `.xbrief.json` on both arms). The test cannot fail, and it asserts a fallback that #2112 removed. Rename it or delete it. Do not keep it as legacy coverage.

**F7 — footnote.** The meaning of positional args depends on the flag: `positional[0]` is `outPath` with `--project-root` and `pendingDir` without it. Under F1, keep an explicit positional `pendingDir` override as it is. Change only the no-positional default. No in-repo caller passes positional args without the flag (the task file uses the flag; release uses the function API).

**F8 — footnote.** `--project-root` on an `xbrief/` with no `.xbrief.json` exits 2 ("No xbrief/ layout found"). It does not render the empty page. That is acceptable, because initialized projects carry `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`.

## Road not taken

Fork 2: keep the vbrief default and fail closed when `xbrief/active` has files the chosen `pendingDir` did not see. Steelman: no behavior change for anyone scripting against a vbrief tree. I rejected it because every other lifecycle reader already refuses vbrief-only trees after #2112, so the default protects a layout the product no longer supports. It also keeps the agent-documented spelling broken. What would flip this verdict: a supported consumer cohort still on unmigrated `vbrief/` trees that renders ROADMAP through the no-flag CLI.

## Verdict

The expected outcome is sound. The active-section renderer already works when given `xbrief/pending`; the reported `deft` command selects a different source tree. The acceptance test must exercise the same no-flag CLI path as the report.

## Pinned recheck

I loaded `roadmap-render.ts` and its internal imports through `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:<path>` and ran a temporary fixture with two valid files in `xbrief/active/` and no `vbrief/`. `main([])` exited 0 and wrote “No pending work items.”; `main(["--check"])` then exited 0. `main(["--project-root", root])` exited 0 and listed both under `## Active`; its `--check` also exited 0. A separate pass with one malformed `xbrief/active/*.xbrief.json` through `--project-root` again wrote the empty message and passed `--check`.

## Findings

1. **blocks-the-design — The current acceptance boundary can certify the wrong command.** [The renderer loads active siblings](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts#L410-L445), and [the existing active test passes it an xbrief pending directory](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.test.ts#L431-L445). But [CLI `main` defaults to `cwd/vbrief/pending`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts#L531-L572), while [the Taskfile supplies `--project-root`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/tasks/roadmap.yml#L13-L31); [the router maps the colon verb to the hyphen handler](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/cli/src/cli-router/route-argv.ts#L260-L277), and [dispatch forwards CLI argv](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts#L2886-L2889). A renderer-only or Taskfile-only fix can pass while the reported `deft roadmap:render` remains broken. Two agents using the different entry points can overwrite the same ROADMAP with incompatible views, and the no-flag check can approve the false-empty one. **Disposition:** make no-flag `deft roadmap:render` and its `--check` resolve the same xbrief lifecycle root as the Taskfile; require a CLI-level regression with active files and no legacy tree.

2. **sharpens-framing — A resolved root still permits false emptiness on read failure.** [`loadVbriefs` returns an empty list on directory-read failure and skips JSON/read errors](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts#L37-L62). The pinned malformed-file check above produced an empty ROADMAP and a passing `--check`. By contrast, [`project:render` records an unreadable scope item](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/core/src/render/project-render.ts#L77-L120). A corrupt or unreadable active file can still make the trusted view say there is no work after the path fix. **Disposition:** include fail-closed handling for recognized lifecycle artifacts in the remedy: report the file/error and refuse to overwrite or validate an empty projection.

3. **footnote — `PROJECT-DEFINITION.plan.items` is corroboration, not the ROADMAP input.** [`project:render` derives those items from lifecycle folders](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86/packages/core/src/render/project-render.ts#L284-L322); roadmap reads those folders directly. The three registry items in the report support the diagnosis but do not require a second projection as the renderer's source.

**Road not taken:** Rendering from `PROJECT-DEFINITION.plan.items` is attractive because the tester already saw the missing scopes there. It is a materialized registry that can lag its lifecycle files, so it would move this trust problem to a second view. I would reconsider if the registry became the canonical scope source with a freshness gate.

## 1. No-flag `deft roadmap:render` still opens `vbrief/pending`

`blocks-the-design`

Evidence. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts` `main` (552-558): with `--project-root`, `pendingDir` is `join(resolveLifecycleRoot(resolve(projectRoot)), "pending")`. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts` `roadmap-render` (2886-2888) forwards `argv` with no injected `--project-root`. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:packages/cli/src/cli-router/route-argv.ts` `routeNamespaceVerb` (260-262) maps `deft roadmap:render` to hyphen stem `roadmap-render` and the same empty rest. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:tasks/roadmap.yml` `render` / `check` inject `--project-root "{{.USER_WORKING_DIR}}"`.

Same-file `renderRoadmapToBuffer` (410-424) already loads pending plus siblings `active/` and `proposed/` plus `completed/`, and emits `No pending work items.` only when every parsed load is empty. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.test.ts` "projects active scopes under ## Active" (431-445) writes an xbrief `active/` sibling of an xbrief `pendingDir` and expects `## Active`. That test never calls `main([])`.

Inventory. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:packages/core/src/render/project-render.ts` `main` (494-503): when there is no positional, `effectiveRoot` is `projectRoot` or `"."`, then `resolveLayoutRootOrCanonical(effectiveRoot)`, and a missing layout writes the migrate hint and exits 2. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:packages/core/src/layout/resolve.ts` `resolveLayoutRootOrCanonical` (62-71) returns `xbrief/` on a migrated tree, throws on vbrief-only, and falls back to canonical `xbrief/` when neither layout exists. `resolveLifecycleRoot` (155-157) is `resolveLifecycleLayout(projectRoot).root` and throws when no `.xbrief.json` exists (146-150). `#2112` already removed the vbrief read path from that resolver.

Re-check on this dest at the SHA: `git ls-tree` has `xbrief/active` (1), `xbrief/proposed` (28), `xbrief/completed` (1643), and no `vbrief/` tree. A four-bucket load of `cwd/vbrief/pending` is empty, so `hasAny` is false. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:ROADMAP.md` already has `## Active`. `git show a16b3ac6bae373205accb5751b48da890e7dac86:content/docs/BROWNFIELD.md` (118) documents `deft roadmap:render` as the consumer write of that view. Tester steps in the issue body are that command after `deft project:render`.

Failure mode. `deft project:render` then `deft roadmap:render` on a migrated tree writes PROJECT-DEFINITION from `xbrief/` and then overwrites `ROADMAP.md` from an absent `vbrief/` tree with `No pending work items.` `checkDrift` (506-524) uses the same `pendingDir`, so `deft roadmap:render --check` after that write compares the empty buffer to the empty file and reports up to date. `task roadmap:render` on the same tree writes the real active/proposed/completed view.
